Do I retreive the past?

Not in a metaphorical way for once. But of course, the rebuild and stuff and... Well, anyway let's catch up first.

First, what happened, where was I? Simple, therapy and breakdowns got bad. That's as much as i need to say because there is not much more truth than that.
Growth and healing are the only reasons I'm back. Maybe I'll talk more, but for now, that's enough.

Why the rebuild? Because the site was fine, but I've learnt a lot. More build, more context, strip the DB, setup dynamic JS.
It's nice to rebuild and use improvement.

So, what is the plan? Rebuild, explore, and upgrade. So, I want to add in Math education, Programing Education, Art will be upgraded, Crochet to be added, and CosmikHysteria will be rebuilt once I am able to go back to it.

That's it really. A rebuild has happened and I'm slowly getting better. Very Slowly.
As for retrieve the past? Nah, I think it's better off dead.

Where should they start?

Does it make sense to even ask? I mean how many points make sense? Does it even make sense again to ask about is it worth starting from a point that makes sense?

Ok let's see where would work:
  1. How about the literal beginning before Dawn?
    No, that's not a great choice, too esoteric with context best explained after some time with the regular events.
  2. What about just after Dawn?
    No, the beginning of Aelveyris requires Dawn context.
  3. Then start in Dawn?
    Not too many characters are better shown later on.
  4. Skip it all and start with Dusk?
    Not starting with the end just doesn't feel right. Plus, Dusk holds too much.
  5. TLS was kind of the beginning to them, why not there?
    If they did, we would still need to narrow further, and it does also feel more disconnected now.
  6. Would anywhere be satisfying for everyone?
    Of course not, everyone is different.
  7. Then why does it matter?
    It truly didn't matter; all that mattered was some start.
Even if the start was from a character, no one will hear from for a long time. Even if this won't make sense for a long time. Even if no one cares.
It's at least started now.
